# 欢迎使用 NSInterpreter
# 基本声明与表达式
let int a = 1 + 2 * 3
let bool ok = !(1 == 7)
print "a=" + a + ", ok=" + ok

# 条件与循环（若 ok 为 true，则把 a 增加到 10）
if ok
  while a < 10
    set a = a + 1
  end
  print "done, a=" + a
else
  print "else branch"
end

# 字符串类型与拼接（string + int/bool 自动转为字符串）
let string msg = "start"
set msg = msg + ", a=" + a + ", ok=" + ok
print msg

# 括号中的算术优先级也可参与拼接
print "sum=" + (1 + 2 * 3)
# 基本四则与括号
let int a = 1 + 2 * 3
print a            # 7
print (a - 1) * 10 # 60
# 比较与逻辑优先级
let int x = 8
let bool ok = (x >= 6) && !(x == 7)
print ok           # true
print x < 3 || x == 8  # true
# if/else/while 示例
let int a = 1
if a < 3
  print 100
else
  print 0
end
while a < 10
  set a = a + 3
end
print a            # 10
# 基础 split 与变量分隔符
let array parts = split "alpha,beta,gamma" by ","
print parts               # [alpha, beta, gamma]
print "parts=" + parts    # 参与拼接自动转字符串

# 动态分隔符与动态源字符串
let string src = "a|b|c|d"
let string sep = "|"
let array items = split src by sep
print items               # [a, b, c, d]

set src = "x" + "-" + "y-z"   # "x-y-z"
set sep = "-"
set items = split src by sep
print "items=" + items        # [x, y, z]
# 连续/首尾分隔符的空项保留（取决于实现）
let array edge = split ",a,,b," by ","
print edge                    # [ , a, , b, ]

# 多字符分隔符
let array segs = split "ab--cd--ef" by "--"
print segs                    # [ab, cd, ef]

# 中文与空格分割
let array cn = split "我 爱 Flutter 开发" by " "
print cn                      # [我, 爱, Flutter, 开发]
# 复杂拼接后分割
let string pre = "hello"
let string suf = "world"
let array duo = split (pre + "-" + suf + "-" + "2025") by "-"
print "duo=" + duo            # [hello, world, 2025]

# 与 let/set/print 交互
let array arr = split "a|b" by "|"
print arr                     # [a, b]
set arr = split "1,2,3" by ","
print "arr=" + arr            # [1, 2, 3]

# 条件中打印数组
let bool ok = 1 < 2
if ok
  print "arr=" + arr
else
  print "no arr"
end
# 创建文件并写入内容，同时演示 bytes 与 line 两种读取
await create "/Users/wilbert/Documents/example.txt" -> file f
await write f "Hello, NS\nSecond Line\n"
await seek f to 0

# 先读取前 5 个字节
await read f bytes 5 -> string first5
print "first5=" + first5        # Hello

# 再按行读取第一行
await read f line -> string firstLine
print "firstLine=" + firstLine   # NS

# 继续读取接下来的 6 个字节
await read f bytes 6 -> string next6
print "next6=" + next6          # Second

# 按行读取第二行（可能为空，视指针位置而定）
await read f line -> string secondLine
print "secondLine=" + secondLine

await close f
# 以追加模式打开，写入后检查文件是否存在；演示 bytes 与 line 两种读取
await open "/Users/wilbert/Documents/example.txt" mode "a" -> file f
await write f "Append!\n"
await close f

await exists "/Users/wilbert/Documents/example.txt" -> bool ok
print "exists=" + ok

# 只读方式打开，先读取前 7 个字节（bytes），再读取第一行（line）
await open "/Users/wilbert/Documents/example.txt" mode "r" -> file fr
await read fr bytes 7 -> string head7
print "head7=" + head7

await seek fr to 0
await read fr line -> string line1
print "line1=" + line1
await close fr
# 删除文件后检查；重建并写入；演示 bytes 与 line 的混合读取
await delete "/Users/wilbert/Documents/example.txt"
await exists "/Users/wilbert/Documents/example.txt" -> bool ok
print "exists_after_delete=" + ok

await create "/Users/wilbert/Documents/example.txt" -> file f
await write f "Recreated\nSecond\n"
await seek f to 0

# 先读取 3 个字节（bytes）
await read f bytes 3 -> string head3
print "head3=" + head3          # Rec

# 再按行读取（line）
await read f line -> string first
print "first=" + first          # reated

# 继续读取下一行（line）
await read f line -> string second
print "second=" + second        # Second

await close f
# 循环按行读取直到 EOF
await create "/Users/wilbert/Documents/example.txt" -> file f
# 循环按行读取直到 EOF
let bool done = false
while !done
  await read f line -> string lines
  print lines
  await eof f -> bool done
end
await close f
# 每次读取 6 字节直到 EOF
await create "tmp/example.txt" -> file f
await write f "Hello-World-Bytes\n"
await seek f to 0

# 每次读取 6 字节直到 EOF
let bool finished = false
while !finished
  await read f bytes 6 -> string chunk
  print chunk
  await eof f -> bool finished
end
await close f
